explication: Spice is a Rust data and AI runtime. A user declares datasets, Spice connects to their sources, optionally maintains accelerated/CDC-fed copies, then serves SQL, search, and AI requests over APIs. The README documents broader connector, model, and distributed capabilities; their implementation wiring is not fully shown in the sampled files, so those links are limited to documented relationships rather than inferred call chains.
